sections.title: Safer phase completion
items: A roadmap phase only finishes when the same coding session has matching plan progress.
If that progress is unavailable, the roadmap stays unchanged instead of entering a pending state.

sections.title: No stale follow-up
items: A rejected completion does not arm a later completion, broadcast a false change, or start the next phase.
You get a clear message explaining that plan progress is missing, so the completion can be retried safely.
